about.description: Cozumel Bar & Grill was founded on September 23, 2010 in Loxley, Alabama by Noel Hurtado. Dedicated to offering an authentic Mexican culinary experience, the restaurant is celebrated for its rich flavors and warm atmosphere. The menu pays homage to Mexico's culinary heritage with flavorful tacos and exquisite traditional dishes. The Cozumel family has grown over the years, extending its culinary influence and legacy of excellence across multiple locations.
about.elevator_pitch: An authentic Mexican restaurant celebrating Mexico's culinary heritage with traditional dishes and warm hospitality across three Alabama locations.
about.vibe: Warm, authentic Mexican dining experience with a focus on traditional flavors and hospitality
